q: Outer automorphisms of the orbit equivalence relation (the full group [T]) are relevant because Dye's reconstruction theorem states:
opts: The full group [T] determines the orbit structure only up to entropy
The orbit equivalence class of T is completely determined by the isomorphism class of [T] as an abstract group
Two systems are orbit equivalent iff they have the same entropy
The full group is always abelian
exp: Dye's reconstruction: the full group [T] = {S : S(x) ∈ Tx a.e.} as an abstract group completely determines the orbit equivalence class of T. Two free ergodic systems are OE iff their full groups are isomorphic.
